title: Learn the Exchange at your pace.
intro: Return any time for a short path through the RFxchange tools available to your organization. Guide progress does not change your business information or permissions.
recommendationBoundary: Recommendations use your current organization information. They do not change permissions, provider status, verification, credibility, or membership benefits.
catalogUpdate: This guide has new content. Your earlier progress remains visible; review the current version when ready.
pathNavigation: Quick Start and role learning paths
explainerDismissed: Explanation closed. You can reopen it here at any time.

questions.happens: What happens if I do this?

states.error: Guide progress could not be saved. Reload and try again.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.summary: Follow the value path using the tools currently available to your organization.

understand.title: Make your organization understandable
understand.body: Review your profile, capabilities, supporting information, visibility, and operating context.

discover.title: See how organizations become discoverable
discover.body: Use the map and Exchange search to find participating organizations in relevant places.

connect.title: Make a useful connection
connect.body: Review the purpose, recipient, and information being shared before sending a referral.

act.title: Use current resources
act.body: Find provider services, make a request, and use published resources.

business.title: Business path
business.summary: Build a clear organization presence, discover capabilities, make useful connections, and use support resources.

profile.title: Confirm your market profile
profile.body: Review suggestions and confirm only the information that accurately represents your organization.

discovery.title: Explore the Exchange
discovery.body: Search participating organizations by capability, geography, and other useful market context.

referrals.title: Send or respond to referrals
referrals.body: Review what will be shared, then track acceptance, decline, contact, and closure separately.

resources.title: Find provider support
resources.body: Compare service territory, availability, eligibility, and why a provider may fit the need.

rfx.title: Create or respond to an RFx
rfx.body: Use RFx tools when they are available to your organization. Unavailable actions are identified in the Exchange.

credibility.title: Use credibility information
credibility.body: Supporting information can add context, but it does not automatically create verification or credibility.

issuer.title: Issuer path
issuer.summary: Use market research and business needs to move from Need → Capability into an RFx when the appropriate tools are available.

market.title: Research the market
market.body: Explore organization capabilities, locations, and resources before defining a need.

resources.title: Understand support resources
resources.body: Review provider services and published resources without treating a listing as qualification for an opportunity.

rfx.title: Author and publish an RFx
rfx.body: Create, review, and publish an RFx when those actions are available to your organization.

evaluation.title: Evaluate responses and outcomes
evaluation.body: Use response and evaluation tools when available; the Exchange identifies actions that are not yet available.

resourceProvider.title: Resource Provider path
resourceProvider.summary: Understand provider application, status, services, requests, communications, and resources.

application.title: Apply for Resource Provider status
application.body: Submit information about your organization and services for review. Submitting an application does not approve it.

profile.title: Maintain your service profile
profile.body: Keep service categories, eligibility, intake, territory, and availability up to date.

discovery.title: Make services discoverable
discovery.body: Choose which services are published so businesses can find the support you provide.

requests.title: Respond to provider requests
requests.body: Accept, decline, redirect, or message about a specific request while keeping the connection separate from the service outcome.

publication.title: Publish resources
publication.body: Create, publish, update, withdraw, or let a resource expire as appropriate.

credentials.title: Training and certification
credentials.body: Training, certification, credibility, and paid benefits appear here only when those features are available.

profile-confirmation.title: Confirm organization profile information
profile-confirmation.what: This updates information your organization uses in its profile and Exchange activity.
profile-confirmation.why: Accurate organization information improves discovery and reduces confusion.
profile-confirmation.happens: Your current permission is checked and the information is saved to your organization.
profile-confirmation.next: The information appears only where its visibility allows. Updating it does not create verification or credibility.

capability-suggestion.title: Review a capability suggestion
capability-suggestion.what: This is an AMACS-based suggestion, not a claim about your organization.
capability-suggestion.why: You decide whether the concept accurately describes what your organization can do.
capability-suggestion.happens: Accept, edit, reject, or leave the suggestion unresolved.
capability-suggestion.next: A capability becomes part of your organization information only after you confirm it through the applicable action.

credential-evidence.title: Add credential or supporting information
credential-evidence.what: This records credential or supporting information provided by your organization.
credential-evidence.why: Supporting information can help others understand a claim, but it is not automatically proof or independent verification.
credential-evidence.happens: The information is saved to your organization and follows the visibility you choose.
credential-evidence.next: Verification or credibility decisions remain separate from simply adding supporting information.

media-visibility.title: Choose media visibility
media-visibility.what: Choose whether an organization media item stays private or can be seen by others.
media-visibility.why: Uploaded material may contain information you do not want to share broadly.
media-visibility.happens: The visibility you choose is saved with the media item.
media-visibility.next: You can change visibility later. Publishing media does not mean RFxchange endorses its content.

additional-location.title: Confirm an additional location
additional-location.what: Add another organization location and choose the appropriate location visibility.
additional-location.why: Additional locations help others understand where your organization operates.
additional-location.happens: The location is checked and saved using the selected privacy level.
additional-location.next: A map marker appears only when the location has enough information and its visibility permits it.

referral-consent.title: Send a referral
referral-consent.what: Create an introduction for the recipient shown and the information displayed before you send it.
referral-consent.why: A useful referral should carry enough context without sharing more than necessary.
referral-consent.happens: The referral is sent and its status can be tracked.
referral-consent.next: The recipient may accept or decline. Sending a referral does not prove contact, service, qualification, or outcome.

referral-response.title: Respond to a referral
referral-response.what: Accept or decline the referral for your organization.
referral-response.why: Your response tells the sender whether the introduction can move forward.
referral-response.next: Acceptance, contact, service, and closure remain separate steps.

provider-application.title: Submit Resource Provider information
provider-application.what: Provide information about your organization, services, service area, and supporting material.
provider-application.why: Resource Provider status is reviewed separately from your ordinary organization profile.
provider-application.happens: You can save a draft and submit it for review when ready.
provider-application.next: The reviewer may request more information, approve the application, or decline it.

provider-connection.title: Connect with this provider
provider-connection.what: Send a request to the provider service you selected.
provider-connection.why: Service area and availability can help explain fit, but they do not promise capacity, eligibility, or service.
provider-connection.happens: The organization and request summary shown to you are shared with the provider.
provider-connection.next: The provider may accept, decline, redirect, or message. A connection is not a service outcome.

provider-response.title: Respond to a provider request
provider-response.what: Respond to this specific request for your Resource Provider organization.
provider-response.why: A response applies to this request and does not promise availability for every future request.
provider-response.happens: Accept, decline, or redirect updates the request status.
provider-response.next: Messages may continue after the response. Service delivery, payment, verification, and outcome are separate.

provider-resource-publication.title: Publish a provider resource
provider-resource-publication.what: Make provider-authored resource content available to the audience you select.
provider-resource-publication.why: Published provider content is information from the provider, not an RFxchange endorsement or qualification.
provider-resource-publication.happens: The resource is published with the visibility and timing you choose.
provider-resource-publication.next: You can withdraw it or let it expire. Publication does not create ranking, a credibility badge, or a guaranteed result.
